newsitem.title: JAPAN: Keisei Electric shares up on Oriental Land hopes.
newsitem.headline: Keisei Electric shares up on Oriental Land hopes.

text.p: Keisei Electric Railway Co Ltd chugged higher in early afternoon trade on Thursday as investors speculated that the listing of Tokyo Disneyland operator Oriental Land may be drawing near, brokers said.
As of 0426 GMT, the shares were up 40 yen at 1,170 yen with turnover of 6.119 million shares, the heaviest in trade volume on the first section of the Tokyo Stock Exchange.
Market participants hope that listing of Oriental Land will inspire a bullish mood in the stock market.
"Keisei shares were recharged by the rise in Sogo shares on Wednesday," one broker said.
Shares in Sogo Co Ltd, a department store operator which holds shares in Oriental Land, attracted buyers yesterday.
The shares closed down four yen at 526 yen on Thursday due to profit-taking.
